# CalmKitchen Designer

> Design, walk through, and pressure-test commercial kitchen layouts in the browser. Part of the HotelOS suite.

CalmKitchen Designer combines a dimensionally accurate 2D editor, a synchronized procedural 3D scene with first-person walkthrough, deterministic busy-service simulation, and evidence-based layout comparison. All geometry is millimetre-native; identical layouts and seeds produce identical results.

## How to use

- App: https://planner.kitchen.hotelos.ai/
- CalmKitchen home: https://kitchen.hotelos.ai/
- Guided tour: open the "?" help menu in the app, then "Start guided tour"

## Workflow

1. **Space** — draw or trace the room outline; drag outline vertices to reshape; add doors, service windows, pillars, and zones. The floor plan is shared by every layout.
2. **Fit-out** — place equipment from the catalog or station templates; select items to configure dimensions, capabilities, and appearance.
3. **Simulate** — run deterministic service scenarios (covers, staff, arrival patterns) with live playback, queues, and pressure findings.
4. **Compare** — diff two layouts or scenarios with metric deltas and evidence-backed findings.

## For agents and MCP clients

The app shell exposes machine-readable state on the root element: `data-app-stage` (space | equipment | simulate), `data-app-view` (plan | scene | split), and `data-app-overlay` (none | compare | auto-layout). All interactive controls carry stable accessible names. Projects round-trip through validated JSON (Save project / Open project), and an atomic workspace API is available for tool integrations.

## Limits

A comparative planning aid — it does not replace architectural, fire, ventilation, food-safety, accessibility, structural, or occupational-safety review by qualified professionals.
